name: Syncthing
author: barticekk@barticekk.eu
description:
Syncthing continuously synchronises folders between devices, peer to peer and encrypted. Useful for
off-site backups of server worlds, sharing configs between nodes, or a private Dropbox replacement.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Syncthing install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -eo pipefail
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

# the official apt repository always carries the current v2 release for every architecture
REPO=https://apt.syncthing.net
DEB=$(curl -fsSL "${REPO}/dists/syncthing/stable-v2/binary-${ARCH}/Packages" \
    | awk -v want="${SYNCTHING_VERSION}" '
        /^Package: / { pkg = $2 }
        /^Version: / { ver = $2 }
        /^Filename: / && pkg == "syncthing" && (want == "" || want == "latest" || ver == want) { file = $2 }
        END { print file }')
if [ -z "${DEB}" ]; then
    echo "Syncthing ${SYNCTHING_VERSION} not found in ${REPO}"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Downloading ${DEB}"
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/syncthing.deb "${REPO}/${DEB}"
rm -rf /tmp/syncthing
dpkg-deb -x /tmp/syncthing.deb /tmp/syncthing
install -m 755 /tmp/syncthing/usr/bin/syncthing /mnt/server/syncthing
rm -rf /tmp/syncthing /tmp/syncthing.deb
/mnt/server/syncthing --version

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p data
if [ ! -f config/config.xml ]; then
    echo "Generating keys and configuration"
    printf '%s' "${GUI_PASSWORD}" | STNODEFAULTFOLDER=1 ./syncthing generate --home=/mnt/server/config \
        --gui-user="${GUI_USER}" --gui-password=- --no-port-probing
    sed -i "s#<listenAddress>default</listenAddress>#<listenAddress>tcp://0.0.0.0:${SYNC_PORT}</listenAddress>#" config/config.xml
    echo "Device ID: $(./syncthing device-id --home=/mnt/server/config)"
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Syncthing installed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: GUI User
variables.description: Login for the web interface. Only applied on the first install; change it later in the GUI.

variables.name: GUI Password
variables.description: Password for the web interface (stored as a bcrypt hash). Only applied on the first install.

variables.name: Sync Port
variables.description: Must be an additional allocation of this server (TCP). Other devices connect to it.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: latest or a release such as 2.1.6. Reinstall to update; config and folders are kept.
